skills.name: Find LCD / Convert Denominators
skills.definition: Determine the least common denominator for two unlike-denominator fractions and rewrite both as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract Numerators
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that already share a common denominator to obtain the fractional difference.

skills.name: Subtract Whole Parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of two mixed numbers (or a mixed number and a whole number) independently of the fraction parts.

skills.name: Borrow Across Whole/Fraction
skills.definition: When the fraction subtraction yields a negative value, regroup one unit from the whole part as denominator/denominator and redo the fraction subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify Fraction
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to its lowest-terms equivalent by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Normalize Improper Mixed Number
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fraction part is itself improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into standard mixed-number form by regrouping the excess into the whole part before subtracting.

skills.name: Same-denominator numerator subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract numerators directly when two fractions (or the fractional parts of two mixed numbers) already share a denominator, keeping that denominator.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Determine the LCD of two unlike denominators and convert both fractions (or fractional parts) into equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Fraction simplification
skills.definition: Reduce a resulting fraction that is not already in lowest terms to its simplest equivalent form.

skills.name: Borrowing/regrouping for negative fraction subtraction
skills.definition: When subtracting fraction parts yields a negative result, borrow one whole unit as d/d from the whole part and redo the fraction subtraction.

skills.name: Zero-part alignment
skills.definition: Treat a bare whole number as 'whole + 0/d' or a bare fraction as '0 + fraction/d' so that whole and fractional parts can be subtracted in parallel.

skills.name: Improper fractional-part regrouping
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into standard mixed-number form by moving whole units out of the fraction before subtracting.

skills.name: Common-denominator numerator subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract numerators of two fractions that already share (or now share, after conversion) a common denominator to obtain the fractional-part result.

skills.name: LCD conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator of two unlike denominators and convert both fractions into equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Whole-part separation and subtraction
skills.definition: Separate a mixed/whole number into whole and fractional components (treating a bare whole number as whole+0/denominator) and subtract the whole-number parts.

skills.name: Borrowing across whole and fraction
skills.definition: When subtracting the fractional parts yields a negative value, borrow one whole unit (expressed as denominator/denominator), reduce the whole part by 1, and redo the fraction subtraction.

skills.name: Normalize improper mixed-number form
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into standard form by incrementing the whole part and reducing the fraction part, before performing subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify final fraction
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms, including recognizing when it reduces to zero or to a whole number.

skills.name: Like-denominator pure-fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract numerators directly when both operands are pure fractions sharing the same denominator, with no whole-number parts involved.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator of two unlike fractions and convert both to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Whole/fraction part-wise subtraction
skills.definition: Separate each operand into a whole part and a fractional part (treating a bare whole number as having a zero fractional part) and subtract the whole parts and fractional parts independently.

skills.name: Borrowing across whole and fraction
skills.definition: When subtracting the fractional parts yields a negative value, borrow one whole unit (expressed as denominator/denominator), add it to the fraction, and re-subtract.

skills.name: Normalize improper fractional part
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into standard form by carrying the extra whole units into the whole-number part before subtracting.

skills.name: Simplify to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce a resulting fraction (or the fractional part of a mixed-number answer) to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Find LCD and convert fractions
skills.definition: Determine the least common denominator for two unlike-denominator fractions and convert both fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract like-denominator numerators
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that already share a common denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Separate whole and fraction parts
skills.definition: Decompose mixed numbers (or whole numbers treated as whole + 0/d) into separate whole-number and fractional components to subtract each independently.

skills.name: Borrow across whole and fraction parts
skills.definition: When the fractional subtraction yields a negative result, borrow one whole unit (as denominator/denominator) and add it to the fraction part before re-subtracting.

skills.name: Handle improper fraction part
skills.definition: Recognize and correctly process a fractional part that is itself improper (numerator ≥ denominator) within a mixed number before or during subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify final fraction
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction (or fractional part of a mixed number) to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.
